To the right, a small dark bowl contains a scoop of vanilla ice cream topped with drizzled chocolate sauce and possibly nuts or cookie crumbles. The folds in the white cloth appear somewhat soft and painterly, lacking the crisp micro-texture of real fabric. Some shadows are diffuse in a way that suggests AI smoothing rather than optical depth of field.
The elliptical rim of the glass pitcher shows slight irregularity in thickness and curvature, not maintaining a perfect geometric ellipse, which is common in AI-generated circular objects.
